description: git-hubby operator: managed GitHub resources, reconciliation, components, GitHub API and work queues. See docs/monitoring.md.

panels.title: Controller pods up
panels.description: Scraped git-hubby pods. One pod is the leader; the others are standby replicas.

panels.title: Reconcile error ratio
panels.description: Reconciliations that returned an error in the selected time range. Errors that only require user action are requeued without an error, see 'Not-ready resources'.

panels.title: Not-ready resources
panels.description: Managed resources whose Ready condition is False (ReconcileFailed or UserActionRequired).

panels.title: Rate-limited requeues
panels.description: Reconciliations postponed because the GitHub API rate limit was (nearly) exhausted, in the selected time range.

panels.title: GitHub API error ratio
panels.description: Failed GitHub API request attempts (HTTP status >= 400 or transport error) in the selected time range.

panels.title: Panics
panels.description: Reconcile panics in the selected time range.

panels.title: Not-ready resources by kind and reason
panels.description: Ready=False per kind and reason. UserActionRequired: the spec or the state on GitHub has to change. ReconcileFailed: a reconciliation failed and is retried.

panels.title: Failing components
panels.description: Component conditions (e.g. RulesetsSynced, WebhooksSynced, TeamMembersSynced) that are False, per kind and reason (SyncFailed or UserActionRequired). Skipped components (e.g. of archived repositories) are not included.

targets.expr: count by (customresource_kind, condition, reason) (${ksm_prefix}_condition{customresource_group="github.interhyp.de", condition!="Ready", reason=~"SyncFailed|UserActionRequired"} == 0)

panels.title: Not-ready resources
panels.description: Resources whose Ready condition is False. The condition message on the resource contains the details.

panels.title: Pending spec changes
panels.description: Resources whose metadata.generation is newer than the generation of their Ready condition, i.e. spec changes not processed yet. Short spikes during reconciliation are expected.

panels.title: Managed resources
panels.description: Number of git-hubby resources per kind.

defaults.noValue: No data: requires the kube-state-metrics custom resource state configuration, see docs/monitoring.md

panels.title: Reconciliations by result
panels.description: requeue_after is the regular result: successful reconciliations are requeued for drift detection. See 'Requeues by reason' for the details.

panels.title: Reconcile error ratio
panels.description: Share of reconciliations that returned an error. Gaps mean no reconciliations.

panels.title: Reconcile duration (P50, P99)
panels.description: Duration of a reconciliation. The controller-runtime buckets end at 60s.

panels.title: Worker utilization
panels.description: Active workers relative to the maximum number of concurrent reconciles. Only the leader reports workers.

targets.expr: sum by (controller) (controller_runtime_active_workers{job="$job", namespace="$namespace"}) / sum by (controller) (controller_runtime_max_concurrent_reconciles{job="$job", namespace="$namespace"})

panels.title: Requeues by reason
panels.description: Why resources are reconciled again. success is the regular drift detection; user_action and awaits_github wait for a change of the spec or on GitHub; rate_limit and startup_spread postpone reconciliations; error is retried with backoff.

panels.title: Component duration (P99)
panels.description: Duration of the reconciliation of each component of a resource (e.g. RulesetsSynced, WebhooksSynced, TeamMembersSynced).

panels.title: Component time share
panels.description: Total time spent per component, independent of how often it runs.

panels.title: Component outcomes (except success)
panels.description: error: retried with backoff. user_action: the spec or GitHub has to change. retry_later: transient state on GitHub. stopped: e.g. repository archived.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, component, outcome) (rate(git_hubby_component_reconcile_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", namespace="$namespace", outcome!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Skipped components
panels.description: Components not reconciled because an earlier component stopped the run on purpose (e.g. archived repositories).

panels.title: GitHub API requests by status
panels.description: Request attempts to the GitHub API (retries and pages counted individually).

panels.title: GitHub API error ratio
panels.description: Share of request attempts that failed (HTTP status >= 400 or transport error).

panels.title: GitHub API latency (P50, P99)
panels.description: Duration of request attempts, including waiting for the secondary rate limit.

panels.title: Response cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of cached lookups (teams, apps, roles) answered from the response cache. Calls without caching are not included.

targets.expr: sum by (cache) (rate(git_hubby_github_response_cache_lookups_total{job="$job", namespace="$namespace", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cache) (rate(git_hubby_github_response_cache_lookups_total{job="$job", namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Response cache misses and invalidations
panels.description: Misses trigger a (paginated) GitHub API call. Invalidations happen when a lookup failed because of stale data.

panels.title: Primary quota remaining
panels.description: Last observed remaining share of the primary rate limit per organization, category and pod. Values are not live queries; check observation age. Organizations can share a quota, so do not sum them.

panels.title: Primary quota and stall threshold
panels.description: Last observed remaining and total budget, plus nonzero stall thresholds, per organization, category and pod. A zero threshold disables stalling and is omitted. Categories have different budgets; use the legend and remaining-share panel for smaller quotas.

panels.title: Rate-limit observation age
panels.description: Time since the last observation per organization, category and pod. Values grow while there is no new observation; standby or formerly leading pods can retain stale values. Compare with the quota panels before interpreting them.

panels.title: Time until observed quota reset
panels.description: Time until the last observed primary quota reset per organization, category and pod. Zero means that observed reset has passed, not that the quota has been refreshed; check observation age.

panels.title: Time until observed stall deadline
panels.description: Time until the last observed primary rate-limit stall deadline, including the reset grace period. Zero means no future deadline in that observation; it does not cover secondary rate limits or other reconciliation delays. Check observation age.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Items waiting to be processed. Delayed requeues are only added once their delay expired.

panels.title: Queue wait time (P50, P99)
panels.description: How long an item stays in the queue before it is processed.

panels.title: Queue adds
panels.description: Items added to the work queue. workqueue_retries_total is not shown: with the priority queue of controller-runtime it also counts delayed requeues and does not indicate errors.

panels.title: Unfinished work
panels.description: Seconds of work in progress that has not finished yet, and the longest running processor. Steadily growing values indicate stuck workers.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU usage per pod.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory per pod.

list.label: kube-state-metrics prefix
